Section B
Answer all the questions.
You may use the case study, your own enterprise experience and your knowledge of enterprise
where appropriate to answer the following questions.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
There are many skills and attributes that are useful to entrepreneurs, including:
• time management
• problem-solving
• taking responsibility
• creativity.
Discuss the importance to Dillon’s enterprise of two of the skills or attributes listed.
Use examples to support your answer.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Dillon wanted to start an enterprise dealing with food. His enterprise would be affected by a
number of laws and regulations, including those in the following areas:
• employment
• production
• selling.
Evaluate which two of these areas of laws or regulations would most affect Dillon’s enterprise.
Justify your decision.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Dillon’s meeting with his parents was not successful because he had not thoroughly prepared
for the negotiation.
Discuss how you could have improved the effectiveness of the meetings you were involved in
during your enterprise project. Use examples to support your answer.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Dillon chose not to work with a partner in his enterprise.
Evaluate whether being a partnership business organisation was, or could have been, the
best option for your enterprise project. Justify your answer.
